cases.expect: React TSX route/component/client facts carry UTF-8 source refs and service namespace.
Equal route paths in different services remain separate; no route-string-only edge.
Duplicate candidates remain ambiguous and do not select the first declaration.
Dynamic path, generated client or absent namespace yields candidate/unresolved gap.
Only explicitly fixture-verified React/TSX patterns are supported; other frameworks are not promoted.
Owned TS profile fixture provider_digest equals the canonical source manifest digest.
CRLF, LF, and lone-CR byte forms of identical UTF-8 manifest files produce one canonical provider digest and the profile fixture uses it.
